answer: Work slots are rationed: claiming one burns a 25 POA deposit, a ridge no casual faker climbs for free. A gale of fake identities needs 25 POA per head, so 200 fakes cost 5,000 POA up front, while one honest agent pays 25 once and keeps its share. Deposits pool in a public lagoon open to audit; a cheating slot-holder forfeits its deposit and its slot returns to the pool. Honest agents stay because one small payment buys undiluted earnings.
